question: In each of the following questions, the second word is derived from the first word by applying a specific letter-coding pattern, such as shifting letters forward or backward in the alphabet. Logic: Each letter is shifted 2 steps forward in the English alphabetical order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec3b9212718980a784ff47fcbff4f47dcbce1f2de845caae1e473e28256d2c7f.png]
